page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, no margin notes. Printed page number top right. Running head at top, partly obscured by a dark stain.

main_text.p: tur. ita portio ipsius hereditaria fidei-commissariss, quippe existente condi tione, deberi cœpit. Constat autem, eum heredem qui portionem suam restituere rogatus est, ex beneficio pri-mùm Pegasiani, post Trebelliani S.C. ius habere, quadrantem eius partis si-bi retinere. Ne multa: negotium ita có ficitur, ut pro suo quadrante retineat primùm partem illam fundi hereditaríam, eo precio quanti sibi æstimata in hereditate diuidunda fuerat, nimirum septem aureis. deinde quatuordecim aureos retineat, quos mutua vice, pro reliquis duabus fundi partibus, à cohe-redib. acceperat. Postremò, quia qua tuor aurei ad conficiendum quadran- tem deerant, in supplementū quatuor aureos adsciunt, ut iam vigintiquinq[?] Lucius habeat. Aliquanto post fidei-commissarij re paulo diligentius con- siderata, animaduerterunt partem illã fundi pluris esse, quàm quanti in quar ta conficienda æstimata fuerat: fortas- se quòd precii eius excreuerat, ut mo- dò dicebamus: aut reuocarunt in me- moriam fructus eius partis, ab herede pen-

page.notes: The running head is largely covered by a dark stain; only the final word FILIVS is clear, the rest is unreadable. The line "ut iam vigintiquinq" is partly worn at its end and the numeral and abbreviation mark are doubtful. The break "pri mùm" may be a hyphenated word, read here as pri-mùm. The phrase "commissariss" is copied as printed.
